detector.positive_label: Draft action error under a specified step-level evaluator; segment-level risk labels must be reported separately under their own name
detector.trigger_rate: head gate positives / evaluated decisions; distinguish gate trigger from actually admitted regeneration
detector.precision: TP/(TP+FP) on known joined draft-error labels
detector.required_evidence: TP/FP/FN/TN, known label coverage, split, evaluator, task grouping, frozen head threshold; no task-to-step label substitution
detector.current_status: No joined delivery step correctness labels; classification cells null

recovery.Recovery Success: draft incorrect -> final correct / regenerated steps with incorrect draft and known pre/post labels
recovery.additional_harm_rate: draft correct -> final incorrect / regenerated steps with correct draft and known pre/post labels
recovery.Regenerated Steps: committed decisions with more than one generation attempt
recovery.Model Calls / Committed Step: all observed generation attempts including discarded/failed attempts / committed decisions; extraction and simulator calls reported separately
recovery.current_label_status: pre/post correctness labels not joined; missing is not zero
recovery.admission_breakdown: Among observed triggered decisions: admitted allocation count, abstention reasons (budget/quota/source), unknown receipt count, regeneration attempted and committed. Admission is not recovery correctness.

reference_drift.definition_status: Requires explicit paired-reference evaluator before use
reference_drift.scope: same task, observable prefix, checkpoint and decoding; classify action/reference disagreement separately from actual action error
reference_drift.available_reference: same_prefix_full_reference currently renders KV size only; it has no reference model action
reference_drift.authorization: do not launch new reference generations merely to fill this optional metric

Complete-source-coverage slice and source-occurrence coverage alongside eviction-inclusive compression
Peak resident total logical KV bytes
Peak allocator allocated/reserved bytes during generator.generate, includes weights/workspaces; not whole-device process totals
additional_metrics_contract.comparison: Show baselines measured under matched cohort/model geometry/dtype/cache scope when available; legacy missing memory is NA. timing.inference_cumulative: sum generator elapsed_sec including encoding/prefill/decode and all recovery attempts

timing.pipeline_wall: instrument named start/end milestones for preparation, dispatch, evaluation, detached scorer and collection; existing incomplete envelopes remain null; report scope and queue time separately
